description: Update embed.ts, widget-client.ts, widget-context.ts, app.js and assets. Script data-token-url defaults to same-origin fresh token endpoint; allow custom provider. Deliver initial token in iframe URL fragment and remove it after reading; use zaq.widget.connect for in-place renewal. Schedule from server times, dedupe requests, bounded retries, visibility/network rescheduling, cold-load stale-token recovery. Keep authenticated listener outside LiveView hook; separate bootstrap-ready from public ready. Preserve exact source/origin checks, container iframe IDs, stylesheet ordering, disposal, and failure reasons. Add browser tests.

comments.text: Implemented same-origin token endpoint/provider bootstrap, fragment delivery and scrubbing, document-level parent listener, in-place renewal, credential metadata/retry/store recovery, and demo readiness separation. Verified mix assets.build, mix test (163 pass), and full Chromium Playwright (80 pass).

title: Implement parent SDK token delivery, bootstrap, and lifecycle
